scope: Independent fresh Open5GS deployments; controlled local availability faults only
threshold: Pooled normal-only calibration deployments, 0.99 quantile higher, strict greater-than; serialized before test scoring
independence: Deployment is the statistical unit; same role vocabulary, fresh processes, keys, UUIDs and independent runner per deployment. Initialization seeds are separate repeats, not extra deployments.
state: Reset between deployments. Recoveries remain causal history but are excluded from fitting labels, calibration threshold and final metrics. Train, calibration and test share no raw observations.
labels: Controller interval and target slot only; non-target NF during a fault and post-fault recovery are excluded from primary metrics; no verifier state determines truth
exposure: Actual monotonic duration of stationary normal sampling intervals. Alerts/hour = flagged NF observations / normal wall-clock hours; consecutive flag runs also reported as alarm episodes.
limitations: Only availability faults, no semantic attack experiment
Two NF types and fixed topology; no test of different NF composition
API paths are fixed read-only discovery and transport probes; semantic diversity is limited
Three final deployments permit exploratory cluster intervals only
Witness uses the existing sampler and its existing trust and lifecycle limitations; no claim of hardware attestation
Sampling periods vary measurement load, not subscriber traffic
Equal thresholds on calibration do not guarantee equal final-test FPR
